name: double-close
title: Double close
fix_goal: A resource should have one owner and one release; after release, clear the ownership marker.
fix_steps: Find the two p101_close calls that release the same descriptor.
Remove the second release or guard it behind fd != -1.
Assign fd = -1 immediately after the first successful close.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the double-close lab is fixed.
lesson: Ownership should be cleared after close so cleanup code cannot close the same descriptor twice.
